Page-level demos: fragmentation, footnotes, and color-scheme dark

FIXTURE-63-PAGE-LEVEL

These properties cannot show inside the audit tables: table rows never split, and only the html element's color scheme is read. The live page-level behavior lives here.

footnote-display / footnote-policy

No footnote layout is rendered in print output today, so footnote-display: block and footnote-policy: line are inert: the marked content stays in normal flow and no footnote area is collected for the page.

This box declares footnote-display: block and still paints as ordinary flowing text.

This box declares footnote-policy: line and still paints as ordinary flowing text.

color-scheme: dark on the root

This paragraph has no author color, so the dark root paints it #e8e8e8 on the #121212 canvas.

forced-color-adjust: none on a nested element is inherited but not read: only the html root's value is consumed, so this line still renders #e8e8e8.

#121212 canvas#e8e8e8 default text

An author color like #ffb020 survives the dark scheme.

This line declares color-scheme: light and still renders the root's #e8e8e8 default: only the html element's scheme is read.

Documented subset: nested color-scheme values are parsed and inherited but have no per-element consumer yet.

break-before: page

This paragraph is the content before the break. The box below carries break-before: page and starts a new page.

break-before: page puts this box at the top of the next page.

break-after: page

break-after: page ends the page after this box.
This block starts the following page because of the break above it.

break-inside: avoid

A 470pt spacer leaves too little room for the 450pt box below, so break-inside: avoid moves it whole to the next page.

break-inside: avoid: this 450pt box stays whole on the next page.

break-inside: auto (for contrast)

With the same spacer and box, the initial break-inside: auto lets the box split across the page boundary.

break-inside: auto: this 450pt box splits across the boundary.
